artwork.prompt: Album cover artwork, square format. A 2024 sleeve deliberately styled after 1955-1979. Medium: offset lithograph with visible halftone rosette and slight colour misregistration. Subject: concentric hand-drawn rays. Palette: saffron, deep indigo, burnt orange, gold. Composition: bold flat shapes, wide margins, one dominant form. No text, lettering, typography, watermarks, logos or signatures anywhere in the image.
